schema: echo-params.1 — the B439 / RS-2.1 manifest: key, unit, range, default, morph class (continuous | jump = flip | device; OQ #33 map in SPEC §9), rate class (FOUNDATIONS ReadCadence), normalised law, smoothing, and each flip key's switch method (contract A11 as amended). Flip keys carry their A11 switch declaration. One key per line.
status: RATIFIED 2026-10-20 by poll (spec revision 2, D-017); revision 3 by poll 2026-10-23 (D-035: fixedControls, actions); revision 4 by poll 2026-10-29 (D-048: time.scale appended, fixedControls now three); revision 5 by D-050 (2026-11-03: the scale key removed, the sync key becomes time.mode, route.mode's first label is standard, fixedControls is Time time.ms, Feedback, Mix, Type route.mode, provisional until T-045: see fixedControlsStatus); a protected path. Keys freeze at first release (B428).

params.name: Time Mode
params.switch: moves the read head: repitch = seeded jump of the read position (continuous, slope within the law's cap); crossfade = equal-gain crossfade, time.xfadeMs; jump = equal-gain crossfade, 3 ms; deferred: a flip between sec and hz moves nothing: both read one time.ms and no signal-path state switches

params.name: Division
params.switch: moves the read head: repitch = seeded jump of the read position (continuous, slope within the law's cap); crossfade = equal-gain crossfade, time.xfadeMs; jump = equal-gain crossfade, 3 ms

params.name: Time Change
params.switch: deferred: no signal-path state switches at the flip; applies from the next time move

params.name: Repitch Law
params.switch: deferred: no signal-path state switches at the flip; applies from the next time move

params.name: Tempo Follow
params.switch: deferred: no signal-path state switches at the flip; applies from the next time move

params.name: Mod Shape
params.switch: seeded jump of the modulation offset: it starts from the value being applied (250 ms value blend, slew-limited)

params.name: Mod Seed
params.switch: seeded jump (contract §12.2): the new streams start from the value being applied

fixedControlsStatus: PROVISIONAL until T-045 (D-050 A2). The row is Time, Feedback, Mix, Type. Time is time.ms, which Echo reads in sec and hz only: in sync its Time does nothing (time.ms is stored, not read; the division is time.div). horde is asked (echo-003) to let the Time entry name its key by mode (time.ms in sec and hz, time.div in sync, one host id) and to draw Type as a selector; until its answer, a synced patch's Time control is dead. The lock file carries no mark.

actions.label: Clear
actions.does: ends the repeats: from the action's sample offset the old audio fades out over 20 ms under the current settings and ends (the load's fade, D-020); no value lands; a performance event, never automated, no history (RS-4.12, ADR-267 A1; SPEC §16.7)
